svg.title: Figure 1 · Record model
svg.desc: The record types the validator checks, one JSON schema each, and the fields by which they reference each other. Arrows point from the field's record to the record it names.
svg.text: The record types the validator checks, one JSON schema each, and the fields by which they reference each other. Arrows point from the
field's record to the record it names.
Generated by tools/previews/record_figures.py from pdac/schemas/*.schema.json and the records. Drafted at independence level I0; nothing shown here is reviewed, verified or

g.text: Terms: AI = artificial intelligence (here, an AI assistant drafting at independence level I0) · CR-nnn = change request record (changes/) · DoD = US Department of
Defense · DQ-nnn = decision question for the project lead (decisions/register.yaml) · EVT-nnn = test or demonstration event record (safety/events/) · HAZ-nnn = hazard
record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · I0–I3 = review independence level (I0 none, e.g. the author or an AI, to I3 independent organisation) · JSON = JavaScript
Object Notation, a data file format · MIL-STD-882E = US DoD Standard Practice for System Safety (11 May 2012, base edition) · REV-nnn = review record (reviews/) ·
SSF-nnn = safety-significant software function record (safety/software/) · SUS-I1 = integrated mechanized walker and observation UAV · SYS-nnn = system safety
requirement record (requirements/SYS-nnn.yaml) · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone) · US = United States · VER-nnn = verification record or case
